name: Gobhi Matar
ingredients: 1 tomato, ginger, jeera, turmeric and 1 tsp oil
steps: Heat oil with jeera and ginger.
Add cauliflower and peas; cover until tender.
note: A vegetable-heavy sabzi with peas and tofu.

inspirationReferences.title: Gobi Matar (Cauliflower With Peas)
inspirationReferences.note: North Indian cauliflower-pea pairing and onion-tomato masala technique; our measured-oil tofu version is distinct.
